0713Electricity and energy

QElectroTech computer-use environment (REA)

earakely-scale/QElectroTechFromRequestComputerEnv-REA

Change the label of a contactor coil to KM1 in an electrical diagram in the QElectroTech editor, using only screenshots, mouse and keyboard, and save.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • GUI agents on CAD-style desktop apps
  • state-checked file edits without a model judge

Reward

How it is scored
Programmatic check
Signal
Pass or fail

A verify.py script reads the saved .qet file and checks the coil label is KM1, its function is unchanged and three components remain.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

hf download earakely-scale/QElectroTechFromRequestComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir qelectrotech-request-request
agent-env run qelectrotech-request-request/bundle --task rename-contactor-km1 --agent claude-code --model <model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download earakely-scale/QElectroTechFromRequestComputerEnv-REA --repo-type dataset --local-dir QElectroTechFromRequestComputerEnv-REA

Needs: Docker and a model provider configured for agentenv.

Evidence

Claude Sonnet 5.5 agent runs passed 3 of 3 times with a verifier script and a recorded witness run

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
